title: Unify MCP tool return envelope (breaking, H4)
description: Give every llm-sanitizer MCP tool one uniform return envelope so consumers parse results the same way regardless of tool. Currently four shapes exist (scan_* = ScanResult JSON / error = {status:error}; redact = bare string; redact_file/url/dir = {status,...}; list_rules = bare array). BREAKING for flow-guard (~7 consumer scripts), so it must ship as a coordinated devel->main release WITH the flow-guard update, and be called out as breaking in the CHANGELOG with a migration note. Target the next minor (0.4.0 on the 0.x line).

items.title: Decide the envelope schema
items.detail: Proposed: every tool returns {"status": "ok"|"error", "tool": "<name>", "data": {...}} on success and {"status": "error", "tool": "<name>", "error": {"type": "...", "message": "..."}} on failure. data payloads: scan_* -> {"result": <ScanResult/DirScanResult JSON>}; redact (inline) -> {"redacted": <text>, "findings_count": N}; redact_file/url/dir -> {"output_path": ..., "findings_count": N, "files_written": [...]}; list_rules -> {"rules": [...]}. Alternatives to weigh: flatten (status + payload at top level, no nested data) vs nested data; whether to keep the raw ScanResult under data.result or hoist findings/summary to the envelope top. Lock this before touching code.
items.resolution: Envelope schema decided: nested {status, tool, data} on success / {status, tool, error:{type,message}} on failure, via centralized ok()/err() helpers. Items 2-5 (implement in server.py, update flow-guard consumers, tests both repos, coordinated 0.4.0 release) are the build.

items.title: Implement the envelope across all 9 tools (server.py)
items.detail: Wrap scan_text/scan_file/scan_url/scan_dir/redact/redact_file/redact_url/redact_dir/list_rules to the chosen schema. Centralize with a small helper (ok(tool, data) / err(tool, type, message)) so no tool hand-rolls the shape. Preserve the H4 fix (errors are still distinguishable), M6 sensitivity validation, and M8 list_rules config-awareness. Update tool docstrings to document the envelope.

items.title: Update flow-guard consumers
items.detail: Update the ~7 flow-guard scripts that parse llm-sanitizer MCP results (scripts/combined_review.py, sarif_review.py, tool_inventory.py, check_facts.py, and the matching tests) to read the new envelope (status + data). Keep a thin compatibility shim ONLY if a staged rollout is needed; otherwise cut over cleanly since both repos release together.

items.title: Tests in both repos
items.detail: llm-sanitizer: update tests/test_server.py to assert the uniform envelope for every tool (ok and error paths). flow-guard: update the consumer tests. Add a schema-shape guard so a future tool that forgets the envelope fails CI.

items.title: Coordinated release + migration note
items.detail: Bump llm-sanitizer to 0.4.0 (breaking tool contract; minor on 0.x), CHANGELOG with a clearly-marked BREAKING section + before/after migration examples. Promote devel->main, release to PyPI, and land the flow-guard update together (flow-guard pins @main / a PyPI version). Tell the maintainer consumers need uvx --refresh after.
